title: address_resolv: Add support for resolving EUI-64 addresses in columns
description:
Add support for caching the resolved strings for EUI-64 addresses so
that they can be supported via address_types and thus placed in the
source and destination columns as appropriate.

The same preference that controls resolving MAC addresses affects
whether or not they are resolved ("Resolve Physical Addresses.")

Ping #15487 (as this is necessary for caching results read from
an ethers file or similar.)
